intro.uz: Sardor blogida bolaligi va hozirgi hayotini solishtiradi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz bolaligingizdan beri qanday oʻzgardingiz?

paragraphs.en: Hi, I'm Sardor, and I'm twenty-two. Today I looked at some old photos from my childhood in Namangan, and I laughed a lot. I have changed so much! So in this post I want to write about my life then and now.
paragraphs.uz: Salom, men Sardorman, yigirma ikki yoshdaman. Bugun Namangandagi bolaligimdan qolgan eski suratlarni koʻrib, rosa kuldim. Men juda oʻzgarib ketibman! Shuning uchun bu postda ilgarigi va hozirgi hayotim haqida yozmoqchiman.

paragraphs.en: When I was ten, I used to be very shy. I didn't use to talk to new people, and I always stood behind my mother at weddings. Now I work at a hotel in Samarkand, and I talk to guests from different countries every day.
paragraphs.uz: Oʻn yoshligimda men juda uyatchan edim. Yangi odamlar bilan gaplashmasdim, toʻylarda doim onamning orqasida turardim. Hozir Samarqanddagi mehmonxonada ishlayman va har kuni turli mamlakatlardan kelgan mehmonlar bilan gaplashaman.

paragraphs.en: I also used to hate vegetables. My grandmother cooked delicious soup with carrots and pumpkin, but I never ate it. Now soup is my favourite food, and I cook it myself on Sundays.
paragraphs.uz: Bundan tashqari, ilgari sabzavotlarni yomon koʻrardim. Buvim sabzi va qovoq solib mazali shoʻrva pishirardi, lekin men uni hech qachon yemasdim. Hozir shoʻrva — sevimli taomim, yakshanba kunlari uni oʻzim pishiraman.

paragraphs.en: Some things are different now, but some things haven't changed. I still love football, and I still play with my old friends when I go back to Namangan. They are taller now, but we laugh like children.
paragraphs.uz: Baʼzi narsalar hozir boshqacha, lekin baʼzilari oʻzgarmagan. Men hamon futbolni yaxshi koʻraman va Namanganga qaytganimda eski doʻstlarim bilan hali ham oʻynayman. Endi ularning boʻyi ancha oʻsgan, lekin biz bolalardek kulamiz.

paragraphs.en: What about you? What did you use to do as a child? Write in the comments!
paragraphs.uz: Sizchi? Bolaligingizda nima qilardingiz? Izohlarda yozing!
